Introduction

You Dayeon, formerly known as Seoryn, is a South Korean singer under Dot Music. She is a former member of the girl group LIPBUBBLE. She made her solo debut on October 20, 2023 with the single album "Down Down Down".

She is also known for participating in Mnet's reality survival show Girls Planet 999.
